blocks.html: Where a sidewalk shed is installed, a sidewalk shed parapet information panel meeting the requirements of Sections 3301.9.2.1 through 3301.9.2.6 shall be posted. Required sidewalk shed parapet information panels shall be in place throughout the duration that the sidewalk shed remains at the site.
